name: Every Line
description: Loops and blocks. iter {times} times {instruction} repeats one instruction, and __COUNTER__ counts the turns from 0. onln {line} apply {instruction} works on one line (lines start at 0, like every index). A line holds only one level of nesting, so put the inner part in a block: blk {name} assoc {instruction}, then cblk {name}.
answer: blk up assoc onln [[__COUNTER__]] apply tucs 0;
